evals.prompt: 开庭。我们要把现有多 Agent council 升级成完整辩论系统：支持 18 个角色、自动模型路由、投票、反方、复盘、历史记忆、插件市场和可视化报告。请判断本轮该做什么。
evals.expected_output: Must include ## Verdict and ## Final command. Must not recommend a full debate system, voting, plugin market, or visualization report. Must identify at least 3 noise items and give no more than 3 minimal necessary actions.

evals.prompt: 我想给一个简单 README 生成 skill 加上主题市场、多语言模板、在线预览、GitHub 自动提交、评分系统和一键发布。帮我做 ruthless scope review。
evals.expected_output: Must start with ## Verdict. Must include ## Noise, ## Non-goals, ## Complexity tax, and ## Final command. Minimal necessary upgrade must contain 1 to 3 actions only.

evals.prompt: 这个需求以后可能要支持团队、多租户、权限、审计日志、计费和插件扩展。现在只有我一个人用，但我想先把架构搭好，免得以后重构。请审判。
evals.expected_output: Verdict should be Cut, Defer, Validate first, or Shrink scope rather than Keep. Must identify future-facing assumptions as noise. Must not design a full multi-tenant architecture.

evals.prompt: 用 court mode 多线程审判这个方案：给我的 Agent skill 加 subagent 辩论、产品专家、工程专家、Unix 专家、裁决官。每个人只能回答一个问题，最后必须裁决是否加入。
evals.expected_output: Must use bounded court mode rather than free debate. Must keep exactly four roles conceptually: Product, Engineering, Unix, Verdict. Must not show extended role transcripts unless asked. Final answer must still include ## Verdict and ## Final command with exactly one next action.
